title: crantzia congesta
intro: Crantzia congesta, commonly known as the false prickly poppy, is a plant species belonging to the family Zygophyllaceae. The health benefits of Crantzia congesta include its potential use in treating fever, rheumatism, and as a laxative. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are said to have a soothing effect on the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Crantzia congesta include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
